# S17 — Run, approve and stop one slice from the CLI

The daemon runs S04's engine with S16's adapter, and the CLI launches,
approves, answers and stops one slice (`engine.owner-surface`).

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**2026-10-19** — From S16 (2026-10-19): each role round needs its own report path; the adapter reads whatever file is there and never deletes one, so a stale report would be read as the new round's. Vendor adapters live under internal/agent/<vendor> (vendor.package-path, adj 80 after renumber), never a vendor/ directory.

trust: unverified; by: Jon R

**2026-10-19** — From S04 (2026-10-19), fix before dogfooding: a gate PASS whose Tests line reports failures still reaches approval; a failed Kill still marks a role lost, so Retry can start a second role; retry after a crash in setup fails on the existing worktree (internal/engine/states.go:30); an owner answer is lost if ork dies mid-answered-round (engine.go:372-380, recover.go:92); a stale role with no end is marked lost even in awaiting-approval (recover.go:70). Later: restart cannot tell a recycled pgid from ork's (no start time in the record); the read-only fingerprint (git status --porcelain) misses edits to already-dirty files; MaxRounds=8 and the review-findings rule are proposed. Commit-versus-finish order is marked Open in docs/design.md.

trust: unverified; by: Jon R

**2026-10-19** — engine.finish-order decided 2026-10-19: on approve run the finish step first, then one commit with code and tracking; a failed commit stops the slice in needs-you without undoing the finish step. Change S04's Approve (internal/engine) and its commit-first test.

trust: unverified; by: Jon R

**2026-10-19** — From S13 (2026-10-19): daemon start failures are invisible (the child's stdio goes to /dev/null), so log the child's stderr to ~/.local/state/ork/daemon.log or report it from the start wait; ork daemon run is missing from the usage text; the integration review's check that two open TUIs do not double CLI calls was never added.

## Why

With it, the owner can run ork's own slices through ork (dogfood).

## Files

- `internal/daemon/`, `internal/ipc/`, `internal/cli/`, `docs/design.md`
  (CLI and Output), and the glue from the engine's Runner to the claude
  adapter.

## Failing tests

- `ork run P ID` prints the plan (worktree, branch, check command, lineup
  from `relay-roles recommend --json` with the first Claude row per role,
  allowlists) and starts only after confirmation; `--yes` skips the
  prompt. That is checkpoint 1.
- `ork approve RUN` commits a slice awaiting approval (checkpoint 2);
  `ork stop RUN` stops it and kills its roles; `ork answer RUN TEXT`
  resumes a paused role with the answer.
- `ork status` lists engine runs with state and what they wait on;
  `needs_you` adds awaiting approval, paused and stopped runs
  (`status.needs-you`).
- The daemon does not idle-exit while a run is active (`daemon.idle`).
- Fakes only; the daemon runs in-process.
